[i]How to Install: [/i][list=1]
[*][size=2]Go to your Stardew Valley installation folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Back up your \Stadew Valley\Contents\Portraits\Robin.xnb[/size]
[*][size=2]Extract the contents of the .zip file into the Stardew Valley\Contents folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Allow the files to overwrite.[/size]
[/list]
[i]NO OVERWRITE Install: [/i](Requires [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url], [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/entoarox-framework.4228/]Entoarox Framework[/url], and [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/xnb-loader.4506/]Xnb Loader[/url])[list=1]
[*][size=2]Go to your Stardew Valley installation folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Extract the contents of the .zip file into the \Mods\XnbLoader\ModContent folder.[/size]
[/list]
I myself tend to use [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/notsnufffie.613609/]notsnuffie[/url]'s [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/diverse-stardewvalley-hiatus-im-dead.109748/]Southeast Asian Robin[/url] because I use their Sebastian, and it's odd not having a mom to match him. However, in their very nice comment on my [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/981/]Maru edit[/url], [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/games/users/1706535/?]SIBIROK[/url] made a very good point in that Maru looks older than her vanilla mother. So I gave it a shot, aging vanilla Robin up a bit. I do like where I landed with her, though I'll probably come back to it in the future ('cause uh, she doesn't really look [i]that [/i]much older...).

A big thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/ConcernedApe]ConcernedApe[/url] for his wonderful game I've spent many hundreds of hours playing and countless more modifying. And an extra kudos for his original Robin Portrait which was used as the basis for my own modified file (and really, not much has changed overall so even more credit to him than me). Also, a big thanks to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/games/users/1706535/?]SIBIROK[/url] for the great idea.
